outcome: Give eCommerce teams a working Hyper-Personalized Recommendation & Cross-Sell Engine capability on their own data — it maximises items-per-basket and cross-category exploration.
overview: Cart and checkout are the last moments at which an online retailer can still change the value of an order, and a recommendation that arrives slowly or generically is worse than none at all. The Hyper-Personalized Recommendation & Cross-Sell Engine mines clickstream, cart and order history for product affinities, then serves them from an in-memory cache fast enough to render inside the checkout page itself. Merchandisers keep control of what may be recommended alongside what, and slow stock can be bundled deliberately. Redington baselines cross-sell contribution and basket size on the customer’s own trading data, then delivers the engine over five weeks and reports the lift against that baseline.
